output.question: Has PepsiCo announced layoffs?
output.answer: Yes. PepsiCo communicated job cuts in its North America food and beverage business through a November 9, 2026 employee letter, with cuts expected over the following week to simplify its structure, according to Reuters. ([uk.marketscreener.com](https://uk.marketscreener.com/news/pepsico-to-cut-around-1-000-jobs-in-north-america-wsj-reports-ce785fd3de81f525)) As reported on November 9, approximately 1,000 roles are being eliminated, according to Bloomberg; that figure should be treated as a reported estimate rather than a verified company-published total. ([news.bloomberglaw.com](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/daily-labor-report/pepsico-to-cut-1-000-jobs-in-north-america-restructuring))

key_facts.fact: Reuters reported on November 9, 2026 that PepsiCo was cutting jobs in its North America food and beverage business, citing an employee letter from North America CEO Ram Krishnan.
As of November 9, 2026, the cuts were expected over the following week and aimed at simplifying the company's structure.
Bloomberg reported approximately 1,000 North America roles being eliminated as of November 9, 2026.

passages.quote: PepsiCo is cutting some jobs in its North America food and beverage business as part of a plan to streamline the unit.
PepsiCo Inc. is eliminating about 1,000 roles in North America

caveats: The employee announcement was verified through reporting quoting the letter, not through a publicly accessible copy of the original letter.
The approximately 1,000-role figure is media-reported; an exact company-confirmed total and detailed breakdown of affected locations and roles were not verified.
